credentials.description: service ID — the user part of HTTP Basic auth, base64(SERVICE_ID:SECRET_TOKEN)
secret token — the password part of HTTP Basic auth

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Maximum number of messages to return.

parameters.name: sent_at
parameters.description: Filter messages sent exactly at this date and time.

parameters.name: sent_at__lte
parameters.description: Filter messages sent before or at this date and time.

parameters.name: sent_at__gte
parameters.description: Filter messages sent after or at this date and time.

example_prompt: List SMS messages I sent this week via NimbaSMS.

next.description: URL of the next page, or null if last page.

previous.description: URL of the previous page, or null if first page.

message_cost.description: Number of SMS consumed: message length in number of SMS × number of recipients.

gotchas: The response is paginated — the 'count' field gives the total but 'results' contains only the current page. Use 'next' to iterate over all pages.
The sent_at__lte and sent_at__gte filters can be combined to define a date range. The accepted date format is not documented — see open_questions.
Each item returned in 'results' includes a message_cost field indicating the number of SMS consumed for that message (length × recipients). Use this field for consumption reports.
open_questions: Sandbox: provider.json declares none and no gotcha documents a test environment — every call reaches production.

GET /v1/messages is absent from the NimbaSMS OpenAPI (https://developers.nimbasms.com/openapi): its query parameters come from the official SDKs — limit, offset, sent_at, sent_at__lte, sent_at__gte from nimbasms-node (https://github.com/nimbasms/nimbasms-node/blob/main/src/messages.js), which types sent_at* as plain strings, and status from nimbasms-cli (src/core/api.py). The accepted date format is not documented: the CLI test (tests/test_api_v2.py) sends a date only, YYYY-MM-DD ("sent_at__gte": "2025-01-01") — whether a full date-time is accepted is unknown.
